newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0320 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in calm trading ahead of the Thanksgiving Day holiday in the United States, dealers said.
One factor causing the real's fall was Thanksgiving Day holiday, dealers said.
Due to the holiday, transactions made today will be settled Monday instead of Friday. Because transactions made Thursday also will be settled Monday, banks preferred to hold dollars today.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed balanced net dollar flows on Wednesday.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real ended flat at 1.0372 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.27 percent to close at 1.098 per greenback, traders said.
